hook.description: Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the congregation.
hook.evidence: The visual of a bride in a ruined cathedral immediately establishes a high-stakes, dramatic setting.

candidates.reason: A powerful confrontation where a jilted bride is rejected by her former lover in favor of a shackled woman.

hook.description: Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.
hook.evidence: The immediate tension of a direct confrontation between a bride and her former lover hooks the viewer instantly.

candidates.reason: Focuses on the emotional climax of the rejection and the shocking reveal of the rival.
